text: Why must braces always be used, even for a single statement?
choices: Adding a second statement later silently changes control flow while the indentation still looks right
The compiler requires them for correctness
Without them the code runs more slowly
They are needed only inside loops
explanation: The indentation says both lines are conditional; the compiler says only the first is. This exact shape allowed Apple's 2014 'goto fail' defect, where a stray line outside a brace-less conditional caused certificate validation to be skipped. It costs two characters.
